meta.name: Hastinapur Ke Veer
meta.description: Hastinapur Ke Veer explores how no child is born into war but shaped into it. Told through a child-centric lens, it delves into Duryodhan's need for validation, Yudhishthira's burden of righteousness, Arjun's longing for approval, Bheem's instinctive justice, and Karna's abandonment. With flawed parenting at its core, the show reveals how love, silence, and choices shape destiny, making war a result of emotional wounds rather than fate.

videos.title: Veers Save Gajanan
videos.overview: A heartwarming beginning awaits as the young Pandavas unite to save Gajanan from danger.

videos.title: Sahadev’s Danger
videos.overview: In a sudden moment, Sahadev falls into a deep well, and a scared Nakul runs to tell their mother. What happens next?

videos.title: Veers Meet Bhishma Pitamah
videos.overview: The Veers rescue Sahdev and come face-to-face with Bhishma Pitamah. What happens now?

videos.title: Pandavas Enter Hastinapur
videos.overview: As Bhishma Pitama brings Kunti and the Pandavas to Hastinapur, how will Duryodhana react to their arrival?

videos.title: Mama Shakuni Triggers Duryodhana
videos.overview: Will Duryodhana follow Mama Shakuni's advice and unite with his brothers to appear stronger than the Pandavas?

videos.title: Veers Face Duryodhana
videos.overview: A royal encounter turns uneasy as the Veers confront Duryodhana. How will they handle the situation?

videos.title: Matwala Haathi
videos.overview: Duryodhana's sinister plot puts Hastinapur's safety and honour at risk. Can the Pandavas handle the situation?

videos.title: Mama Shakuni's Clever Advice
videos.overview: As fear clouds Duryodhana's mind, can Mama Shakuni's words help him regain his confidence?

videos.title: Dhritarashtra's Promise To Duryodhana
videos.overview: Will Dhritarashtra's words strengthen Duryodhana's hopes, or deepen existing rivalries?

videos.title: The Gurukul Decision
videos.overview: As the Pandavas' future is discussed, what tension begins to emerge in Hastinapur?

videos.title: Bheem And Duryodhana Face Off
videos.overview: Bheem and Duryodhana face off in a powerful wrestling match, leaving everyone wondering who will come out stronger.

videos.title: Duryodhana's Thirst For Throne
videos.overview: Mama Shakuni suggests Duryodhana that the throne demands a sacrifice. What will he sacrifice for the crown?

videos.title: Khel Diwas
videos.overview: Duryodhana reaches out to the Pandavas in friendship, but with Mama Shakuni around, nothing is ever as it seems. What sinister game is Shakuni playing now?

videos.title: Bheem’s Haunting Dream
videos.overview: Is Bheem's endless nightmare a warning of something to come, or a clue from the past?

videos.title: Mama Shakuni's Wicked Scheme
videos.overview: Mama Shakuni plays a risky card that could alter everything. What's next?

videos.title: Duryodhan’s Plot Against Bheem
videos.overview: Duryodhan tricks Bheem with poisoned kheer, and after Bheem falls unconscious, he throws him into the water.

videos.title: Bhima’s Sudden Disappearance
videos.overview: Bheem is nowhere to be found, and questions keep mounting. What awaits him, and who will uncover the truth?

videos.title: Bheema Entrapped In Naaglok
videos.overview: As the Pandavs search for Bheem near the river, he finds himself trapped in the world of snakes. How will the mighty warrior navigate this dangerous underworld and find a way back home?

videos.title: Battle In Naaglok
videos.overview: As Bheem faces the challenge in Naaglok, everyone wonders if he will win or will Naaglok be stronger?

videos.title: Bheem Learns Of Duryodhana’s Betrayal
videos.overview: Bheem learns the shocking truth in Naaglok that Duryodha poisoned him and threw him into the river. now what will Bheem do next?

videos.title: Arjuna’s Quest For Truth
videos.overview: Arjun sets out to find who pushed Bheem into the water. Will he succeed in uncovering the truth?

videos.title: Bhishma Senses Duryodhana’s Deception
videos.overview: Bhishma Pitamah senses that Duryodhan is hiding something about Bheem's sudden disappearance. Will he finally reveal the truth?

videos.title: Kunti Misses Bheem
videos.overview: Lost in Bheem's memories, Kunti feels he has returned when she sees Duryodhan, but soon realizes it isn't him.

videos.title: Hastinapur Awaits Bheem’s Return
videos.overview: People of Hastinapur keep talking about Bheem's return, but now everyone believes he is gone. what will happen next?

videos.title: Bheem’s Return Sparks Fear In Duryodhana
videos.overview: Bheem's unexpected return shocks everyone in Hastinapur. While Bhishma Pitamah feels relieved and asks him what happened, Duryodhan is gripped by fear, worried that his dark secret may finally be exposed.

videos.title: Duryodhana’s Crime Exposed By Bheem
videos.overview: After Bheem reveals that Duryodhan threw him into the water and that he spent many days in Naaglok, how will the Pandavas react, and what will they do to make Duryodhan pay for his actions?

videos.title: Bheem's Powerful Revenge
videos.overview: With his strength greater than ever, Bheem is ready to take revenge on Duryodhan. but does Duryodhan have any chance of saving himself?

videos.title: Bheem's Clever Deception
videos.overview: Bheem saves Duryodhan's life but pretends to be injured. As Bhishma Pitamah suspects Bheem is hiding the truth, will his secret be exposed?

videos.title: Dhritarashtra Faces His Son’s Betrayal
videos.overview: After Mahaganga reveals the truth that Duryodhan poisoned Bheem and threw him into the river, will his father finally punish him for his cruel actions?

videos.title: Kunti Confronts A Shocking Revelation
videos.overview: Kunti learns the shocking truth that Duryodhan poisoned Bheem and threw him into the Ganga to kill him.

videos.title: Will Duryodhan Apologize
videos.overview: Even after his mother asks him to seek forgiveness from Kunti and Bheem, will Duryodhan finally put aside his pride and apologize?

videos.title: Kunti's Lessons For The Pandavas
videos.overview: In the jungle, Kunti teaches the Pandavas valuable life lessons, the true values of humanity, and how to face every challenge with strength and wisdom.

videos.title: Guru Dronacharya's First Lesson
videos.overview: When Duryodhan throws the ball into a deep well, Guru Dronacharya steps in and shows everyone that even the impossible can be made possible.

videos.title: The Search For Guru Dronacharya
videos.overview: The Pandavas begin their journey to Kamadam Mountain in search of Guru Dronacharya, but will they successfully reach their guru?

videos.title: The Pandavas' Tough Test
videos.overview: The Pandavas are trapped in a magical illusion they cannot break. How will they find a way out?

videos.title: The Pandavas' Masterstroke
videos.overview: The Pandavas use their intelligence and strategy to escape the Rakshasa's trap and defeat him with their clever plan.

videos.title: Duryodhan's Evil Plan
videos.overview: Duryodhan secretly teams up with a Rakshasa and sets a dangerous plan in motion against the Pandavas.

videos.title: Guru Dronacharya's Gurukul
videos.overview: Guru Dronacharya brings the Pandavas and Kauravas to the Gurukul, where they begin their journey of learning discipline, knowledge, and warfare.

videos.title: Arjun Gets Punished
videos.overview: When Arjun arrives late, Dronacharya refuses to listen to any excuses and punishes him. But who was responsible for locking the door and causing his delay?

videos.title: Arjun Won't Give Up
videos.overview: The Pandavas ask Arjun to come down, but he refuses, saying he must complete Dronacharya's punishment. How will the Pandavas save him now?

videos.title: Gurudev's Tough Teaching
videos.overview: After finishing his punishment, Arjun and the others feel hungry, but Gurudev reminds them that hunger is their enemy and offers only fruits for their meal.

videos.title: Guru Dev Learns Duryodhan's Plan
videos.overview: Guru Dev discovers that the Kauravas have hired outsiders to do their work while they relax, all to make the Pandavas look inferior. What action will Guru Dev take now?

videos.title: The Search For Vanpal Begins
videos.overview: Believing that Vanpal destroyed the Gurukul, the Pandavas and Kauravas set out to find him and uncover who Vanpal really is.

videos.title: Duryodhan’s New Plan
videos.overview: Duryodhan feels that Gurudev only favors the Pandavas and decides to win his attention. Will Duryodhan succeed in his plan?

videos.title: Gurudev’s Firm Decision
videos.overview: Pitamah visits the Gurukul to meet the children, but Gurudev asks him to leave, saying he wants to raise them with the right values and proper education.

videos.title: Ashwathama’s Arrival At The Gurukul
videos.overview: As Ashwathama arrives at the Gurukul, Gurudevi welcomes him, but Gurudev refuses to let him take part in the ritual, saying discipline matters more than appearances. What will happen next?

videos.title: Gurudev’s Test For The Students
videos.overview: Gurudev warns the students that weapons are not a game and must be used with respect and responsibility. When they ask how they can prove their worth, will Gurudev put them through a challenging test?

videos.title: The Gurukul Challenge
videos.overview: The Pandavas confidently announce that Arjun will emerge victorious in the challenge against Duryodhan. Will Duryodhan prove them wrong and turn the tide in his favor?

videos.title: Gurudev's Lesson On True Success
videos.overview: By using his intellect, Arjun succeeds in Gurudev's challenge; however, Gurudev explains that true achievement stems from wisdom, moral values, and discipline, not simply from finding the fastest solution.

videos.title: Gurudev's Strict Punishment For Arjun
videos.overview: Gurudev punishes Arjun for breaking the rules and bans him from attending his classes for seven days. What will the Pandavas do now?

videos.title: Gurudev's Lesson For Duryodhan
videos.overview: Duryodhan complains that the Pandavas are secretly teaching Arjun. But Gurudev reminds him to focus on himself, saying that while Arjun has been kept away from the class, he has not been kept away from knowledge.

videos.title: The Path Of Bhiksha
videos.overview: Gurudev sends Pandavas and Kauravas for bhiksha, where they witness life's struggles. Will this journey change their perspective forever?

videos.title: Gurudev's Greatest Test
videos.overview: As the Pandavas learn profound life lessons through their bhiksha journey, Gurudev prepares a legendary archery test that will reveal the true master among his disciples.

videos.title: Arjun's Ultimate Test
videos.overview: While others learn in class, Arjun learns through hardship. Will he pass Gurudev's legendary bird's-eye challenge?

videos.title: Arjun's Focused Aim
videos.overview: Gurudev tests Arjun's focus as he perfectly targets the parrot's eye. Impressed by his skill, Duryodhan's jealousy sparks a conflict.

videos.title: Eklavya Seeks Guru
videos.overview: Arjun hones his archery skills as Duryodhan's push fuels rivalry among the princes. Meanwhile, Eklavya seeks Dronacharya's guidance.

videos.title: Eklavya Faces Danger
videos.overview: Duryodhan's act against Arjun angers the Pandavas, while Eklavya's journey to meet Dronacharya turns dangerous when lions attack. Will he survive?

videos.title: Arjun And Vikarna
videos.overview: Ashwathama trains Arjun while Vikarna strives to outshine him. Meanwhile, Eklavya faces a tough challenge on his quest to meet Dronacharya.

videos.title: Will Ashwathama Leave Arjun?
videos.overview: Duryodhan's lies drive a wedge between Ashwathama and Arjun. Will their friendship survive, or is this the end of their bond?

videos.title: Duryodhan's Jungle Trap
videos.overview: Driven by revenge, Duryodhan sends the Pandavas and Ashwathama into a dangerous forest through deceit. Will the Pandavas escape Duryodhan's deadly trap?

videos.title: Pichhach Attacks Pandavas
videos.overview: The Pandavas face a deadly Pichhach attack in the jungle. Can they escape its trap and uncover Duryodhan's evil plan?

videos.title: Ashwathama’s Tough Punishment
videos.overview: Gurudev punishes Ashwathama for leaving the Gurukul. Duryodhan tries to turn him against the Pandavas. Will their friendship survive?

videos.title: Arjun Masters His Senses
videos.overview: Arjun takes control of his senses while the Pandavas unite to fight the Pichhachas and free the jungle from their threat.

videos.title: Pishaach Attack The Pandavas
videos.overview: Arjun defeats a Pishaach attacking the Gurukul with Gangajal, while Duryodhan schemes against the Pandavas through Ashwathama.

videos.title: Arjun’s Heroic Transformation
videos.overview: Gurudev gives Arjun a bow and declares that he is no longer just a prince of Hastinapur, but a true hero who fights for others.

videos.title: Eklavya’s Wish
videos.overview: Eklavya comes to the Gurukul to learn archery and hopes that Gurudev will accept him as his disciple.

videos.title: The Gada Challenge
videos.overview: Eklavya leaves Gurukul, while Bheem struggles to control his strength. He challenges Duryodhan to a Gada duel, leading to an intense clash.

videos.title: Gurudev Stops The Gada Battle
videos.overview: During the Gada battle between Bheem and Duryodhan, Gurudev stops the fight and forbids Bheem from entering the arena.

videos.title: Gurudev Scolds Ashwathama
videos.overview: Gurudev questions Ashwathama for attacking Arjun and scolds him. Later, Ashwathama gets emotional and seeks his father’s approval.

videos.title: Can Bheem Rescue His Brothers?
videos.overview: Mayavi Yatudhani makes Bheem and his brothers lose consciousness through food. Bheem regains consciousness and rushes to save them.

videos.title: Bheem Defeats Yatudhani
videos.overview: Bheem sets out to rescue his brothers from Yatudhani’s trap. He finally saves them and defeats Yatudhani.

videos.title: Duryodhan Faces Bheem’s Might
videos.overview: Bheem returns with the Arun Jyoti Kamal and impresses everyone by defeating Duryodhan with controlled strength, beginning his Gadayuddh training.

videos.title: Gurudev Begins Weapons Training
videos.overview: Gurudev begins training the Pandavas and Kauravas in different weapons, teaching them about their uses, powers, and techniques.

videos.title: Brothers Face Off In Battle
videos.overview: Guru Dron divides the Pandavas and Kauravas into two mixed armies for a challenge, testing their loyalty, teamwork and sense of duty.

videos.title: Yudhishthir Finds A New Route
videos.overview: Duryodhan orders Bheem and Arjun to break the bridge, forcing Yudhishthir to find another route. Both teams then race ahead by solving clues.

videos.title: Arjun Saves Ashwathama
videos.overview: Ashwathama enters a cave to find a clue, followed by Arjun. When danger strikes, Arjun saves him, and Bheem later helps them escape from the cave.

videos.title: Dushasan’s Emotional Breakdown
videos.overview: Dushasan feels hurt when Duryodhan praises Ashwathama and dismisses him. Yudhishthir consoles him with a heartfelt hug before they move ahead.

videos.title: Yudhishthir Leads The Way
videos.overview: Yudhishthir leads his team to victory with his wisdom, earning Guru Dronacharya's praise and an honour for his remarkable leadership.

videos.title: The Deadly River Mystery
videos.overview: Arjun and the princes uncover clues behind the mysterious crocodile attacks, while a deadly conspiracy threatens to strike from within.

videos.title: Arjun Saves Dronacharya
videos.overview: Arjun uses his sharp skills to save Dronacharya from a crocodile attack, earning his Guru’s praise while leaving Ashwatthama deeply hurt.

videos.title: Chitra Accuses Madhuli
videos.overview: As Chitra points to Madhuli as the poisoner, Madhuli cleverly deflects suspicion, leaving Bhishma and Vidur determined to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Duryodhan Finds His Rival
videos.overview: Dushasan uncovers a shocking truth, while Jarasandh plots to destroy the Gurukul. Will Guptrajan warn Bhishma before it's too late?

videos.title: Duryodhan’s Quest For Power
videos.overview: Duryodhan discovers the Kala-Ayas Mudrika, which grants the strength of a thousand elephants. Will he succeed in obtaining its power?

videos.title: Madhuli’s Deadly Plot
videos.overview: Madhuli plots to kill Dhritarashtra using his elephant, but Bhishma’s changed routine foils her plan. Will her deadly secret be exposed?

videos.title: Madhuli Faces The Pandavas
videos.overview: Madhuli enters the palace disguised as Charumati, but Arjun and Yudhishthir grow suspicious, while Shakuni teaches Duryodhan the game of Chausar.

videos.title: Duryodhan’s Secret Mission To Moolsthan
videos.overview: Duryodhan seeks the Mudrika’s power as rivalry with the Pandavas intensifies after Yudhishthir is named best student, while Arjun uncovers a secret.

videos.title: Yudhishthir Earns The Honour
videos.overview: Yudhishthir earns the title of Gurukul’s best student, fuelling Duryodhan’s rivalry, while the Pandavas struggle with Kunti's absence.

videos.title: Arjun Follows Madhuli
videos.overview: Arjun and Bheem follow Madhuli through the market, but she senses someone following her, making it difficult for them to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Madhuli’s Secret Trail
videos.overview: Arjun and Bheem continue tracking Madhuli through the market, but when she senses their presence and changes her route, will they still be able to discover the truth behind her mysterious actions?

videos.title: Kunti Teaches The Pandavas A Lesson
videos.overview: Kunti playfully punishes the five Pandavas for leaving without informing her, then reminds them to stay together and avoid taking unnecessary risks.

videos.title: The Pandavas Discover A Vital Clue
videos.overview: The Pandavas uncover a vital clue when a man’s earrings match those of the attackers. His answer leads them to Charumati, sending them on a new search.

videos.title: Madhuli Traps The Pandavas
videos.overview: The Pandavas find Dushala unconscious in a secret tunnel and realize Dhritarashtra is Madhuli’s target, while the palace comes under attack.

videos.title: Madhuli Faces Dhritarashtra
videos.overview: Madhuli's true identity comes to light as she prepares to take on Dhritarashtra. Will she succeed in her mission?

videos.title: Bhishma Challenges Jarasandh
videos.overview: Bhishma confronts Jarasandh and dares him to rescue Dhritarashtra, promising to surrender Hastinapur if Jarasandh defeats him.

videos.title: Duryodhan's Biggest Triumph
videos.overview: Duryodhan gains the power of the Mudrika and saves Shakuni before returning to Hastinapur. Meanwhile, the Pandavas rescue Dhritarashtra.

videos.title: Duryodhan's Next Move
videos.overview: Duryodhan flaunts his newfound strength and learns a secret about Jarasandh, hoping to use it against the Pandavas.

videos.title: Duryodhan Joins Forces With Jarasandh
videos.overview: Duryodhan secretly leaves Hastinapur and forms a bold alliance with Jarasandh, while Bheem races to uncover his hidden plan.

videos.title: Duryodhan’s Secret Pact
videos.overview: Duryodhan secures peace with Magadh and wins praise, while secretly plotting with Jarasandh to clear his path to the throne.

videos.title: Surya Putra Radheya
videos.overview: Ved Vyas reveals Karn's true identity as Surya Putra Radheya, who goes to great lengths to help his mother complete her vrat.

videos.title: The Warrior Within Radheya
videos.overview: Radheya refuses to accept his fate as a Saarthi and dreams of becoming a Maharathi. His remarkable archery skills soon prove his true potential.
